11
Blazing-eyed warriors who coat 
their skin in mud and stone. 
Their ancient combat style 
mimics the basilisk's regal poise 
and ferocious strikes.
Weapons: Boomerang, club, 
dagger, spear, spear-thrower
Armor: None
Hit Points: 1d8 per level
Basilisk Blood. You have ADV 
on CON checks to avoid harmful 
maladies, poisons, or afflictions.
Petrifying Gaze. One creature of 
your level or less that meets your 
gaze must pass a DC 15 CON 
check or be petrified for 1d4 
rounds. It still takes damage as 
normal while petrified.
You can use this talent a number 
of times per day equal to your 
CON modifier (minimum 1).
Stone Skin. Add 2 + half your 
level (round down) to your AC if 
you are otherwise unarmored. 
You have advantage on checks 
to hide in natural environments.
Basilisk Warrior Class
